text: The first control replay remains live and has emitted valid structured scalar events and captured states; final output neutrality is still pending. Checkpoint analysis and per-structure/trajectory plotting code is drafted; plots have not been generated or visually reviewed. The analysis seal was created before any checkpoint scoring. Added a tested live-launch resume guard so a failed/missing/mismatched initial control cannot be skipped when continuing the panel (two tests passed). The already-running frozen driver and its numeric source are unchanged; resume-guard-seal.json identifies the additional launcher guard separately. Launch continuation through the current trajectory_study.py wrapper after the first receipt passes, not by bypassing the guard with a direct frozen-driver command. No numerical policy or state-capture selection changed.
